description: This file defines React components for a toggle group UI element, utilizing Radix UI's toggle group primitives, with variant and size customization via context and utility functions.

methods.name: ToggleGroup
methods.description: A React component that renders a toggle group with customizable variants and sizes, providing context to its toggle items.

methods.name: ToggleGroupItem
methods.description: A React component representing a toggle button within the toggle group, inheriting context for variant and size, with custom styling.
